title: 3 spots left for our Online Intro to CLO coming up in 2 weeks
content:
Hi Everyone!

We have our next Intro to CLO coming up with 3 spots left. If you are new to CLO This is one of the best ways to jump start your CLO journey. If you know the basics this can be a great way to learn all the best tips and tricks to keep your CLO skills growing!!!

Part 1 - July 7-9

Part 2 - August 4-6

All information can be found at the link below. We would love to have you there

<https://www.eventbrite.com/e/intro-to-clo-online-2-part-workshop-tickets-1990518234623?aff=oddtdtcreator>
